resources.string: General guidance, not medical advice. Use a weight you can control and stop if you feel pain or dizziness.

string-array.name: guide_bench_press_steps
string-array.item: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip a little wider than your shoulders and lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight, keeping your back slightly arched.

string-array.name: guide_bench_press_avoid
string-array.item: Bouncing the bar off your chest.
Flaring your elbows straight out to the sides.

string-array.name: guide_incline_db_press_steps
string-array.item: Set the bench to about 30–45° and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your upper chest, elbows a little tucked.
Press up and slightly together until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: guide_incline_db_press_avoid
string-array.item: Setting the bench too steep, which turns it into a shoulder press.
Letting the dumbbells drift too far apart at the bottom.

string-array.name: guide_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Start in a high plank with your hands just wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line and lower your chest towards the floor.
Push the floor away until your arms are straight again.

string-array.name: guide_push_up_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your hips sag or pike up.
Only going halfway down.

string-array.name: guide_deadlift_steps
string-array.item: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, keep your back flat and push the floor away with your legs.
Stand tall with hips and knees locked, then lower the bar the same way.

string-array.name: guide_deadlift_avoid
string-array.item: Rounding your lower back.
Letting the bar drift away from your legs.

string-array.name: guide_barbell_row_steps
string-array.item: Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees, bar hanging below your shoulders.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower with control.

string-array.name: guide_barbell_row_avoid
string-array.item: Jerking the weight up with your hips.
Standing too upright, which shortens the movement.

string-array.name: guide_lat_pulldown_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your thighs under the pads and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Let it rise slowly until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: guide_lat_pulldown_avoid
string-array.item: Pulling the bar behind your neck.
Swinging your body to move the weight.

string-array.name: guide_pull_up_steps
string-array.item: Hang from the bar with your hands a bit wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest up until your chin is over the bar.
Lower yourself all the way down with control.

string-array.name: guide_pull_up_avoid
string-array.item: Kicking or swinging to get up.
Stopping short of straight arms at the bottom.

string-array.name: guide_squat_steps
string-array.item: Rest the bar on your upper back with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Brace, then sit your hips back and down until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your whole foot until you are standing tall.

string-array.name: guide_squat_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your knees cave inwards.
Lifting your heels off the floor.

string-array.name: guide_leg_press_steps
string-array.item: Sit with your back flat on the pad and feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the platform until your knees are bent to about 90°.
Press back up without locking your knees hard.

string-array.name: guide_leg_press_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your lower back lift off the pad.
Locking your knees at the top.

string-array.name: guide_lunge_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall holding dumbbells and take a long step forward.
Lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through your front heel to come back up.

string-array.name: guide_lunge_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your front knee collapse inwards.
Leaning your upper body too far forward.

string-array.name: guide_rdl_steps
string-array.item: Stand holding the bar with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs, keeping your back flat.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then drive your hips forward.

string-array.name: guide_rdl_avoid
string-array.item: Rounding your back to reach lower.
Turning it into a squat by bending your knees too much.

string-array.name: guide_calf_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand on the balls of your feet on a step, heels hanging off.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower your heels slowly below the step.

string-array.name: guide_calf_raise_avoid
string-array.item: Bouncing quickly through the reps.
Cutting the range short at the bottom.

string-array.name: guide_ohp_steps
string-array.item: Hold the bar at your shoulders, hands just outside them.
Brace your core and glutes and press the bar straight up.
Move your head through once the bar passes your face and lock out overhead.

string-array.name: guide_ohp_avoid
string-array.item: Leaning back to push the weight up.
Pressing the bar out in front instead of overhead.

string-array.name: guide_lateral_raise_steps
string-array.item: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height, then lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_lateral_raise_avoid
string-array.item: Swinging the weights up with your body.
Shrugging your shoulders towards your ears.

string-array.name: guide_bicep_curl_steps
string-array.item: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows by your sides and curl the weights up.
Squeeze at the top, then lower all the way down.

string-array.name: guide_bicep_curl_avoid
string-array.item: Swinging your body to lift the weight.
Letting your elbows drift forward.

string-array.name: guide_tricep_pushdown_steps
string-array.item: Face the cable and grip the handle with your elbows tucked at your sides.
Push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Let it come back up slowly, keeping your elbows still.

string-array.name: guide_tricep_pushdown_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your elbows move forward and back.
Leaning over the handle to push with your body.

string-array.name: guide_dip_steps
string-array.item: Support yourself on the bars with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.

string-array.name: guide_dip_avoid
string-array.item: Dropping too deep and straining your shoulders.
Swinging your legs for momentum.

string-array.name: guide_plank_steps
string-array.item: Rest on your forearms with elbows under your shoulders.
Lift your body so it forms a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and glutes and breathe steadily.

string-array.name: guide_plank_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your hips sag towards the floor.
Holding your breath.

string-array.name: guide_crunch_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms on your chest and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause, then lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_crunch_avoid
string-array.item: Pulling on your neck.
Using momentum instead of your abs.

string-array.name: guide_kettlebell_swing_steps
string-array.item: Stand with feet wider than hips and hinge to grab the kettlebell.
Hike it back between your legs, then snap your hips forward.
Let it float to chest height, then guide it back down.

string-array.name: guide_kettlebell_swing_avoid
string-array.item: Squatting the weight up instead of hinging.
Lifting the bell with your arms.

string-array.name: guide_burpee_steps
string-array.item: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back in, stand up and jump with your arms overhead.

string-array.name: guide_burpee_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your hips sag in the plank.
Landing stiff-legged from the jump.

string-array.name: guide_bodyweight_squat_steps
string-array.item: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned out slightly.
Reach your arms forward and sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Push through your heels to stand tall again.

string-array.name: guide_bodyweight_squat_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your knees cave inwards.
Rounding your back or lifting your heels.

string-array.name: guide_jumping_jack_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet out wide while swinging your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady rhythm.

string-array.name: guide_jumping_jack_avoid
string-array.item: Landing on flat, stiff legs; stay light on the balls of your feet.
Letting your arms only go halfway up.

string-array.name: guide_mountain_climber_steps
string-array.item: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee towards your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and your core tight the whole time.

string-array.name: guide_mountain_climber_avoid
string-array.item: Bouncing your hips up high.
Letting your shoulders drift behind your hands.

string-array.name: guide_glute_bridge_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

string-array.name: guide_glute_bridge_avoid
string-array.item: Arching your lower back at the top.
Pushing through your toes instead of your heels.

string-array.name: guide_wall_sit_steps
string-array.item: Lean your back flat against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent at about 90°, feet under your knees.
Hold the position and breathe steadily.

string-array.name: guide_wall_sit_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your knees go past your toes.
Resting your hands on your thighs to push.

string-array.name: guide_leg_raise_steps
string-array.item: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Keeping your lower back pressed down, lift your legs until they point up.
Lower them slowly without touching the floor.

string-array.name: guide_leg_raise_avoid
string-array.item: Arching your lower back off the floor.
Swinging your legs with momentum.

string-array.name: guide_high_knees_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms and stay on the balls of your feet.

string-array.name: guide_high_knees_avoid
string-array.item: Leaning back as you get tired.
Letting your knees only come up halfway.

string-array.name: guide_superman_steps
string-array.item: Lie face down with arms stretched out in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.

string-array.name: guide_superman_avoid
string-array.item: Throwing your head back; keep your neck in line.
Lifting too fast and jerking your back.

string-array.name: guide_pike_push_up_steps
string-array.item: Start in an upside-down V with hips high and hands shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head towards the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

string-array.name: guide_pike_push_up_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your hips drop into a normal push-up.
Flaring your elbows straight out to the sides.

string-array.name: guide_bodyweight_lunge_steps
string-array.item: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Step back with one leg and lower until both knees are bent to about 90°.
Push through your front heel to return, then switch legs.

string-array.name: guide_bodyweight_lunge_avoid
string-array.item: Letting your front knee collapse inwards.
Leaning your upper body forward.
